content: In the case of BERT, $\mathcal {F}_\mathrm {LM}$ is a Transformer BIBREF4, followed by a final Feed-Forward Net. During pretraining, the Feed-Forward Net predicts the identity of masked wordpieces. When finetuning on a supervised task, it is usually replaced with a randomly initialized task-specific layer.
